summary: Diagnosed and fixed OBS-03 runtime blockers after compile-fix rework. TC-OBS-03-INT-05 internal_error was caused by a use-after-free cursor param in audit pagination; fixed by copying decoded cursor UUID into arena-owned memory before query execution and by using typed timestamp/UUID cursor predicates. TC-OBS-03-INT-06 setup failure was caused by schema drift in users seed data and unsupported SET LOCAL parameterization; fixed seed insert to include username/status and switched actor context set to set_config(..., true). Also fixed unrelated INT-01 allocation leaks that blocked the integration command from exiting cleanly.
